description: This source file contains the implementation of the CustomerApproval controller class in PHP for the OpenCart platform. It manages customer approval processes including listing, approving, and denying customer approval requests within the admin panel.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Controller class managing customer approval requests, enabling listing, approval, and denial of customer approval entries within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the customer approval page, loading language, setting titles, and preparing breadcrumbs for navigation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of customer approvals, setting up filtering, pagination, and view rendering.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and filters customer approval entries based on request parameters, constructs pagination, and renders the list view.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Processes approval of selected customer or affiliate approvals, updating their status and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Processes denial of selected customer or affiliate approvals, updating their status and returning a JSON response.
